ET AUSTIN, Texas—(BUSINESS WIRE) — November 9, 2026 — Faeth Therapeutics (Nasdaq: FTH), a clinical-stage oncology company developing multi-node therapies for cancer patients, including its lead program PIKTOR, today announced topline clinical data from its Phase 2 trial (FTH-PIK-201; NCT06463028; GOG-3111) of PIKTOR, an investigational all-oral combination of serabelisib and sapanisertib, given with paclitaxel to patients with advanced endometrioid endometrial cancer and a PI3K/AKT/mTOR (PAM) pathway mutation who had received at least one prior line of therapy.
The Phase 2 trial is ongoing, and the topline data include 42 patients with endometrioid endometrial cancer who had a median of 2 prior lines of therapy (range 1-4 lines).
